summary.text: Tarah Probst is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 189, which she has represented since December 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She previously served as mayor of Stroudsburg Borough, Pennsylvania.

paragraphs.text: Probst graduated from East Stroudsburg High School in 1988.
She earned a B.A. in communications from King's College in 1992 and a J.D. from Widener University in 2003.
Probst assumed office in the House on December 1, 2022, succeeding Rosemary Brown.
